    Gibbs sampler dispatcher for post-SCM models

    gibbs_postscm.Rd

    Dispatches to the appropriate internal Gibbs sampler depending on whether the prepared data object includes a Bayesian probit first stage, moderators, and whether the model is single- or multi-outcome.

    gibbs_postscm(gdata, n_iter = 1000, burn_in = 500, control = NULL)

    Arguments

    gdata

    Output from prepare_data_general().

    n_iter

    Integer. Total number of Gibbs iterations.

    burn_in

    Integer. Number of initial iterations discarded.

    control

    Optional list of sampler control parameters and priors. Supported entries:

    Sigma_gamma_prior

    Prior variance for second-stage \(\gamma\) coefficients. Scalar or vector of length ncol(Z_block).

    mu_gamma_prior

    Prior mean vector for \(\gamma\). Defaults to zero.

    a_sigma_alpha_prior, b_sigma_alpha_prior

    Shape/rate for the observation-noise variance prior.

    a_sigma_tau_prior, b_sigma_tau_prior

    Shape/rate for the coefficient-dispersion prior.

    mu_delta_prior

    Prior mean for first-stage probit coefficients \(\delta\). Numeric vector of length ncol(X_fs). Defaults to zero.

    Sigma_delta_prior

    Prior variance for \(\delta\). Scalar or vector of length ncol(X_fs). Default 10.

    Value

    A list of posterior draws.

    Performance

    For large datasets with many treated units, install RhpcBLASctl to enable multi-threaded BLAS operations: install.packages("RhpcBLASctl"). The package will use it automatically if available.
